transcript.content: Cluster 28's top up-regulated markers are: lgals2b, anxa4, s100a1, ccka, pax4, tm4sf4, si:zfos-2372e4.1, cldn15la. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: intestinal enteroendocrine / CCK-like secretory endocrine cell, mature.**

## Evidence
- **ccka** — cholecystokinin peptide marker; ZFIN says it is expressed in digestive system/gut/intestine and predicts neuropeptide hormone activity/digestion, fitting an intestinal enteroendocrine identity. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-100922-79)
- **scg3** — secretogranin III; expressed in endocrine system and predicted active in secretory granule membrane / protein localization to secretory granule, supporting a peptide-secreting endocrine state. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-040426-1725)
- **pax4** — endocrine-pancreas/gut TF; ZFIN links it to endocrine pancreas development, glucose homeostasis, pancreas regeneration, and expression in endocrine system and gut, supporting digestive endocrine lineage but not uniquely intestinal. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041210-244)
- **anxa4** — expressed in hepatopancreatic ducts and intestinal secretory cells at 80 hpf, supporting digestive epithelial/secretory context rather than neural-only endocrine identity. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-IMAGE-160803-17)
- **cldn15la** — tight-junction/adhesion-associated epithelial marker expressed in digestive system/gut/liver, consistent with intestinal epithelium. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010328-12)
- ZFA **intestinal epithelial cell** is an epithelial cell of the intestine; EECs are scattered in the intestinal epithelium, matching ccka+ secretory endocrine epithelial cells. [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0009399)
- GO **peptide hormone receptor binding** supports interpreting ccka-family peptide output as hormone/neuropeptide signaling. [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:0051428)

## Caveats
- **pax4/scg3** can also fit pancreatic endocrine cells, but **ccka + intestinal/gut expression + anxa4 intestinal secretory signal** favors intestinal EEC over pancreatic islet.
- No supplied β-cell hormones such as **ins**; pancreatic B cell is therefore not the best call.

**Verdict:** intestinal enteroendocrine cell, mature — confidence medium

Independent second read (alternative-hypothesis pass) for the same cluster:

**Best call: intestinal/gut epithelial endocrine-like population; deepest defensible tier is enteroendocrine-leaning intestinal epithelium, not a specific subtype.**

## Evidence
- **cldn15la** — curated expression includes gut/intestine and intestinal epithelial cell, supporting intestinal epithelium rather than pancreas-only identity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-010328-12/expression).
- **s100a1** — 5 dpf expression is restricted to intestinal tract; sections show strong intestinal epithelial-cell labeling [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-FIG-080402-54).
- **ccka** — peptide-hormone marker; together with gut epithelial markers fits an enteroendocrine hypothesis. ZFA defines enteroendocrine cell as an endocrine cell in gastrointestinal epithelium [record](https://zfin.org/action/anatomy/anatomy-view/ZFA%3A0009097).
- **pax4** — supports endocrine pancreas / gut endocrine programs: expressed in endocrine system and gut; acts in endocrine pancreas development and glucose homeostasis [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041210-244).
- **tm4sf4** — alternative pancreatic endocrine/progenitor hypothesis: study reports pancreatic tm4sf4 expression and role in endocrine pancreas differentiation [record](https://www.zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-110719-2).
- **anxa4** — supports hepatopancreatic duct / pancreatic-islet alternative: expressed in digestive/endoderm structures and later hepatopancreatic ducts/pancreatic islets [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-PUB-140903-10).
- Anatomy comparison: intestinal epithelial cell is “an epithelial cell of the intestine” [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0009399); endocrine pancreas is islet-cell groups producing insulin/glucagon/somatostatin [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA%3A0001260). GO’s enteroendocrine differentiation term matches hormonally active gut epithelial cells [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO%3A0035883).

## Caveats
- Pancreatic duct/endocrine progenitor remains plausible because **anxa4**, **pax4**, and **tm4sf4** are hepatopancreatic/endocrine-linked.
- Without stronger subtype hormones, I would not call a specific enteroendocrine subtype.

**Verdict:** intestinal epithelial endocrine-like / enteroendocrine-leaning cell — confidence medium
